children: Hoechst GmbH sold an equal number of Sanofi India shares at the same price as Sanofi Healthcare India acquired the stake through the open market
Sanofi Healthcare India, a promoter group entity of Sanofi India, has acquired a 15.19 per cent stake in the pharmaceutical company for Rs 1,068.20 crore through an open market transaction.
Sanofi Healthcare India purchased 35 lakh shares of Mumbai-based Sanofi India at an average price of Rs 3,052 per share, according to block deal data on the National Stock Exchange (NSE).
The transaction gives Sanofi Healthcare India a 15.19 per cent stake in Sanofi India.
Meanwhile, Hoechst GmbH, another promoter entity of Sanofi India, sold an equal number of shares at the same price, according to the NSE data.
Hoechst, an entity of the Sanofi Group, acts as a holding company for investments in companies of the group.

Following the transaction, Hoechst’s holding in Sanofi India declined to 45.17 per cent from 60.37 per cent. However, the transactions do not change the combined shareholding of the promoters and promoter group entities in Sanofi India.
Sanofi Healthcare India is a major subsidiary of global pharmaceutical company Sanofi SA and has been operating in India for nearly seven decades.
Shares of Sanofi India closed nearly 3 per cent higher at Rs 3,138 apiece on the NSE on Thursday.
